tender.title: Procurement of Replacement BA Compressor for Cornwall Airport Ltd
tender.description:
Corserv Solutions Ltd on behalf of Airport Ltd is undertaking the procurement of Replacement BA Compressor
CAL invites suitably qualified suppliers to submit a quotation for the supply of the equipment in accordance with the requirements set out below. This procurement is being conducted in accordance with the principles of the Procurement Act 2023, including transparency, equal treatment of suppliers, and securing value for money.
tender.submissionMethodDetails:
Please send you submission or questions to procurement@corservltd.co.uk
www.corservltd.co.uk

documents.description:
Capability to remotely charge BA cylinders within an adjacent dedicated charging room.
Maximum charging pressure of 300 Bar.
Minimum free air delivery rate of 320 litres per minute.
Breathing air quality compliant with BS EN 12021 (latest version).
Three-phase 400V, 50Hz electrical supply.
Maximum motor rating of 7.5kW.
Automatic condensate drain.
Automatic pressure switch to stop compressor at final pressure.
High temperature and overpressure safety shutdown.
Emergency stop facility.
UKCA marked.
Supplier to provide commissioning, testing and operator training.
Supplier to provide operation and maintenance manuals.
Minimum 12-month warranty from commissioning.
UK-based servicing and technical support available.
Or equalivlent
